title: Check if CPU supports x86_64 (64-bit)
summary: Verify if your processor supports the x86_64 architecture, which is required for Arch Linux. This is done by checking for the 'lm' (long mode) flag in the CPU information.

aliases.text: есть ли lm флаг в cpuinfo

steps.explain: Search for the 'lm' (long mode) flag in the CPU info file. If it appears, the CPU supports x86_64.
steps.expect: Output containing 'flags ... lm ...' indicates support. No output means the CPU does not support x86_64.
